# Wuttiphong Butta (วุฒิพงษ์ บุตตา) — Software Engineer

> Thai name: วุฒิพงษ์ บุตตา, nickname โพสต์อิท (Post-it). Software engineer in Thailand building AI systems, internal platforms and web products — from the model behind the API to the interface people use. Status: open to work. Focus: AI, platform, web.

Site: https://wuttiphongbutta.netlify.app/
Email: wuttiphong4work@gmail.com
Languages: English, Thai

## Selected work

### QwenMythos — self-trained open-weight LLM (2026)
- Role: AI Engineer and model owner
- Approach: Curated a Thai reasoning dataset (OpenMythos), fine-tuned a Qwen3.5 text base into a 4.2B Recurrent-Depth model, published safetensors weights and a Q4_K_M GGUF quantisation with a 262k context window.
- Outcome: Open weights anyone can run locally through llama.cpp or Ollama, with the training method written up in Thai.
- Model card: https://huggingface.co/Wuttiphong23/qwenmythos_Version_1.0
- Files: https://huggingface.co/Wuttiphong23/qwenmythos_Version_1.0/tree/main

### AI OCR — document intelligence (2026)
- Role: AI Engineer
- Approach: Layout detection before recognition; a fine-tuned vision model served behind a job queue.
- Stack: PyTorch, CUDA, OCR

### STQ Orbit — data pipeline to QuickBooks (2026)
- Role: AI & Technology Specialist
- Approach: A correction and validation layer in front of QuickBooks. Every record can be edited and checked before it syncs; receipts issue automatically once data passes.
- Outcome: Accounting team spends up to 50% less time correcting data, filing receipts and chasing invoices.

### ORBIT Platform — internal platform (2026)
- Role: AI & Technology Specialist
- Approach: Event-driven services, a schema registry and a typed SDK for every consumer.
- Stack: TypeScript, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL

### AI Chatbot (RAG) — retrieval-augmented assistant (2026)
- Role: AI & Technology Specialist
- Approach: Hybrid retrieval with a reranker and a citation attached to every answer.
- Stack: RAG, embeddings, FastAPI

### SEO · GEO · AEO — search, generative and answer engines (2026)
- Role: AI & Technology Specialist
- Approach: Technical audit, answer-engine markup, structured data, performance budget enforced in CI.
